classification_rules: Randomize dataset/target selection, never evidence interpretation.
Do not promote an office street address to headquarters without explicit headquarters semantics.
Preserve source conflicts rather than silently reconciling them.
Treat the July Rules and Bylaws Committee action as a proposal and the August full-DNC vote as the subsequent approval event.

findings.result: LinkedIn explicitly labels Washington, DC as headquarters; no headquarters street inferred.
Current first-party contact page lists 1250 Eye Street NW, Ste. 330, Washington, DC 20005.
LinkedIn lists the same primary Washington street/postal code as Ste. 250; discrepancy preserved.
Full DNC approved the six-state 2028 early primary window on August 15, 2026, corroborated by Reuters and AP.

data.method: Global dataset-first selection from the 27 physical dig roots on current main. Excluded meta root free-range, recent hourly root cia, and Ohio/Columbus root wef-columbus under the three-run diversity rule, leaving 24 eligible roots. Python MT19937 choice with seed 4874923695856756444 selected dnc. The DNC organization queue contains 1,379 organization leads and 8,025 investigation targets; the HQ-capable high-priority organization shortlist [Democratic National Committee, Democracy Partners, ActBlue Technical Services, MissionWired, NGP VAN, Scale to Win] was sampled with the same seed and selected Democracy Partners. TDD added labeled-headquarters and labeled-office address parsing. HQ/location evidence came from the firm's first-party contact page and LinkedIn company profile. Current-news search then reviewed DNC official material plus Reuters/AP reporting and selected the August 15 full-DNC approval of the 2028 early-state calendar as a material governance event.
data.research_question: What defensible public HQ/location enrichment and material current news improve the globally selected DNC / Democracy Partners research surface?

summary: Global two-stage randomized Auto-Dig pass selecting the DNC root and Democracy Partners, enriching headquarters/office-location semantics, preserving a live suite-number conflict, and ingesting the DNC's August 2026 2028-calendar decision.
